local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "CustomGUI"
screenGui.Parent = playerGui
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local function createNotification(text)
    local notifFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    notifFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 50)
    notifFrame.Position = UDim2.new(1, -260, 1, -60)
    notifFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
    notifFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    notifFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
    notifFrame.Parent = screenGui
    notifFrame.ClipsDescendants = true

    local uicorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    uicorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
    uicorner.Parent = notifFrame

    local notifText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    notifText.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -10)
    notifText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 5)
    notifText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    notifText.Text = text
    notifText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    notifText.TextScaled = true
    notifText.Parent = notifFrame

    notifFrame.Position = UDim2.new(1, 260, 1, -60)
    TweenService:Create(notifFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {Position = UDim2.new(1, -260, 1, -60)}):Play()
end

local function createGui()
    local guiFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    guiFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 100)
    guiFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0.5, -50)
    guiFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
    guiFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    guiFrame.Parent = screenGui

    local uicorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    uicorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 15)
    uicorner.Parent = guiFrame

    local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    textLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -10)
    textLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 5)
    textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    textLabel.Text = "execute many times to get more money"
    textLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    textLabel.TextScaled = true
    textLabel.Parent = guiFrame

    local closeButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
    closeButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 25, 0, 25)
    closeButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 5)
    closeButton.Text = "X"
    closeButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    closeButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 0, 0)
    closeButton.Parent = guiFrame

    local closeUICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    closeUICorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
    closeUICorner.Parent = closeButton

    closeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        guiFrame:Destroy()
    end)

    local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos

    local function update(input)
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        guiFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                                      startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end

    guiFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = guiFrame.Position
            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    guiFrame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            dragInput = input
        end
    end)

    game:GetService("UserInputService").InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and input == dragInput then
            update(input)
        end
    end)
end

createNotification("execute many times to get more money")
createGui()
